decision: Create a separate SliceLab source repository with APC as a pinned submodule
why: Preserve the music workspace and make the framework dependency explicit

decision: Keep the authorized sample local and excluded from Git
why: Development authorization does not imply publishing the recording

decision: Correct the initial two log timestamps; they were planning placeholders, not captured event times
why: Keep the audit record honest without rewriting history
result: Actions verified; exact initial timestamps not captured

decision: Choose native JUCE with a preallocated live Rubber Band path
why: Native input and resizing fit Linux; cached render banks cannot cover arbitrary host tempo changes

decision: Build JUCE helper with a user-owned Linux dependency prefix
why: The laptop lacks development headers and the APC shell builder assumes macOS

decision: Pin four-stem BS-RoFormer with overlap 8 and three-pass augmentation
why: Use a strong real model with a documented recipe and checkpoint grant
result: Real GPU outputs and cancellation verified; no ground-truth quality score
